decisions.basis: Case-0059 dossier: exact NL12 activation coverage clause, exact transition and event bindings, and supplied unreachable-consumer facts.
decisions.reason: The quoted NL12 clause requires the activation conditions to be consumed by a reachable transition in the collision avoidance system. The supplied binding identifies the exact event and transition:line:75 under CollisionAvoidanceSystem, while the candidate facts state that the transition is unreachable and that the reachable consumer set is empty. The proposed independent-subsystem interpretation is only a possibility and is expressly unsupported by the supplied closed hierarchy, so it is defeated.
decisions.violated_obligation: The activation conditions must have a reachable consumer transition in the collision avoidance system scope.

decisions.basis: Case-0059 dossier: exact NL6 completion clause, HighwayMode-to-FinishState transition binding, and supplied reachable zero-outgoing frontier fact.
decisions.reason: The NL6 clause states that HighwayMode ends by transitioning to FinishState on auto_finished=true. The exact supplied facts bind transition:line:65 and report reachable FinishState with zero outgoing transitions as a deadlock leaf. That establishes failure of the stated stable-completion reading. An intentional-terminal interpretation is not supported by an exact terminal clause, formal terminal edge, or explicit terminal fact in the dossier, so it is defeated.
decisions.violated_obligation: HighwayMode must reach stable completion at FinishState without an unfinished terminal frontier.
